entry.name: port
entry.label: Localhost port the cc-pill daemon listens on.

entry.name: slotChars
entry.label: Width of the text slot, in average characters. The panel keeps this width while sessions run.

entry.name: openOnHover
entry.label: Open the session card when the pointer rests on the widget (otherwise on click).

entry.name: hoverDelay
entry.label: How long the pointer must rest before the card opens, in milliseconds.

entry.name: hitPadding
entry.label: Extra clickable space on each side of the pill, in pixels.

entry.name: showCats
entry.label: Let the cats (Charlie and Lily) run laps while Claude works.

entry.name: style
entry.label: Look: "plasma" follows the Plasma colour scheme; "porcelain" is the macOS cc-pill look.

entry.name: customFont
entry.label: Use the font below instead of the panel's font.

entry.name: fontFamily
entry.label: Font family (empty: the panel's font).

entry.name: fontSize
entry.label: Font size in points (0: the panel's size).

entry.name: fontWeight
entry.label: Font weight, 100 to 900.

entry.name: fontItalic
entry.label: Italic text.

entry.name: colors
entry.label: Colours: "scheme" follows the colour scheme (or the porcelain palette); "custom" uses the colours below.

entry.name: textColor
entry.label: Text colour.

entry.name: accentColor
entry.label: Accent: working sessions and the voice.

entry.name: attentionColor
entry.label: A session that needs you.

entry.name: doneColor
entry.label: A finished session.

entry.name: backgroundColor
entry.label: Capsule fill behind the pill.

entry.name: borderColor
entry.label: Capsule border colour.

entry.name: capsule
entry.label: With scheme colours: tint a capsule behind the pill.

entry.name: borderWidth
entry.label: Capsule border width in pixels (0: none).

entry.name: cornerRadius
entry.label: Capsule corner radius in pixels (99: fully round).
